editionLabel: Queen Games English edition by Dirk Henn, copyright 2013
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently bought stock shares goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: On the opening turn, the active player uses a Trade tile and draws the movement tile randomly. Turns proceed clockwise.
